verdict.rationale: Audit logging of flag changes is a fair governance question for a feature-flag platform, but the evidence pack never mentions an audit log or change history recording who changed what, when, and to which value. The only related items cover exposure monitoring and SSO/SCIM access management, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value
